## Summary
Describe the problem and the proposed change.

## Scientific impact
- Does this change a biological/computational assumption?
- Does it change a verdict rule or interpretation?
- What alternatives/limitations remain?

## Validation
- [ ] Tests added/updated
- [ ] `make test` passes
- [ ] `make lint` passes
- [ ] `mkdocs build --strict` passes
- [ ] Tutorial behavior checked when relevant

## User-visible changes
Describe CLI, output-schema or documentation changes.

## Checklist
- [ ] Focused PR
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] Changelog updated if behavior changed
- [ ] No private/sensitive data committed
